resources.name: Portfolio admin API
resources.description: Manual tests of the admin API. Start the server (`pipenv run python manage.py runserver`), set `password` in the environment, then run the folders in order. Each request name ends with the expected status.

resources.name: 01. Auth
resources.description: Login is also sent automatically when the token expires.

resources.name: Login → 200
resources.description: Returns `access` and `refresh`. The environment reads `access` from here.

resources.name: 02. Access control
resources.description: A non-staff user cannot get a token at all, so the 403 case is only covered by the automated tests.

resources.name: Admin root → 200
resources.description: Lists the 8 collections.

resources.name: Admin root with a bad token → 401
Create → 201
resources.description: Response has every field, including display_order, is_visible and timestamps.

body.text:
{
  "institution": "Université de Rennes",
  "degree": "Master",
  "field_of_study": "Computer Science",
  "grade": "Distinction",
  "location": "Rennes",
  "start_date": "2015-09-01",
  "end_date": "2017-06-30",
  "description": "Created from Insomnia.",
  "display_order": 0,
  "is_visible": true
}

resources.name: Create with required fields only → 201
resources.description: end_date null, is_current true, is_visible true, display_order 0.

resources.name: Create with read-only fields → 201, they are ignored
resources.description: id is not 999, is_current is false, created_at is now.

resources.name: Create without required fields → 400
resources.description: Errors on institution, degree and start_date.

resources.name: Create ending before it starts → 400
resources.description: Error on end_date.

resources.name: Update (PUT) → 200
resources.description: Omitted optional fields (grade, location...) keep their values.

resources.name: PUT without required fields → 400
resources.description: Errors on institution and start_date.

resources.name: Public detail of the hidden entry → 404
Admin retrieve of the hidden entry → 200
resources.description: The admin API still reaches it.

resources.name: PATCH only end_date before stored start → 400
resources.description: Checked against the stored start_date (2015-09-01).

resources.name: PATCH only start_date after stored end → 400
resources.description: Error reported on end_date.

resources.name: PATCH end_date null (ongoing) → 200
resources.description: is_current becomes true.

resources.name: Create with required fields only → 201
resources.description: employment_type defaults to full_time.

resources.name: 05. Tags
resources.description: skills/, tools/ and methodologies/ behave the same; the kind comes from the route.

resources.name: Create duplicate skill → 400
resources.description: Error on name.

resources.name: Same name as a skill, as a tool → 201
resources.description: Names are unique per kind only.

resources.name: Kind in the body is ignored → 201
resources.description: The tag appears under skills/, not tools/.

resources.name: Retrieve the tool id under skills/ → 404
resources.description: Tag ids are shared, but each route only reaches its kind.

resources.name: PUT the same name → 200
resources.description: Keeping its own name is not a duplicate.

resources.name: 06. Projects
resources.description: Uses the experience and tags created in the previous folders.

resources.name: Create work project with tags and missions → 201
Create side project with required fields only → 201
resources.description: experience null, tags/missions/achievements empty lists.

resources.name: Create with missions not a list → 400
Retrieve → 200
resources.description: experience and tags are ids.

resources.name: Reorder and edit missions → 200
resources.description: The list replaces every mission, in this order.

resources.name: PATCH title only, missions and tags kept → 200
Invalid PATCH changes nothing → 400
resources.description: Retrieve afterwards: title and missions are unchanged.

resources.name: Public detail of the hidden project → 404
Public detail of a project of a hidden experience → 404
Create expiring before issue → 400
resources.description: Error on expiration_date.

resources.name: Writing specializations is ignored → 200
resources.description: specializations stays unchanged; it is edited on the specialization.

resources.name: PATCH expiration before stored issue date → 400
Certification now lists the specialization → 200
resources.description: specializations contains the new id.

resources.name: 09. Cleanup (deletes)
resources.description: Removes what the collection created. After running it, the chained ids point to deleted rows: re-run the Create requests before the other ones.

resources.name: Its project is gone → 404
resources.description: Deleting an experience deletes its projects and their missions.

resources.name: Logout (blacklist refresh token) → 200
resources.description: The access token keeps working until it expires.
